mission: Phase 2: Integration Layer Design — Backend↔Forge Mapping
description: Cross-reference matrix linking backend-manifest → forge-manifest. Maps each forge element to its backend source with effort estimates, wallet context field mapping, connect modal step mapping, loading/error/empty states, gaps analysis, and dependency graph.

connections.forgeElement: Landing page DemoCard — mock portfolio demo cycle
connections.loadingState: skeleton card with pulsing stat placeholders; demo cycle runs while real data loads
connections.errorState: fallback to mock demo cycle if contract call fails; inline error banner 'Position data unavailable'
connections.emptyState: show demo with empty values (0.00) instead of mock values; CTA to connect wallet
connections.notes: DemoCard currently uses hardcoded mock data. Real data requires CoFHE permit unlock. During loading, show the demo animation but label as 'loading sample data'. Needs staggeredReveal pattern for cipher unlock.

connections.forgeElement: Landing page Ticker — scrolling protocol stats
connections.loadingState: show cached/fallback stats; use last-known values from sessionStorage while fresh data loads
connections.errorState: keep scrolling ticker with stale data; add error indicator (muted warning icon) if refresh fails
connections.emptyState: show placeholder stats ('block #—', 'gas · —', etc.) with muted styling
connections.notes: Pure public data endpoint, no encryption needed. Ticker auto-refreshes every 30s. Polling interval configurable.

connections.forgeElement: Dashboard positions list — user's on-chain positions
connections.loadingState: skeleton list items (5 rows with pulsing bars); per-position loading indicator
connections.errorState: per-position error badge; retry button; 'Position data unavailable' fallback with last-cached data
connections.emptyState: empty group header 'No positions yet' with CTA to supply or explore strategies
connections.notes: Positions require CoFHE permit to decrypt balances. Supply side is euint128, borrow balance is euint128. Use staggered reveal pattern. Positions include: venue (Lending Pool / Vault), asset, side (supply/borrow/vault), amount (encrypted), APY (public).

connections.forgeElement: Dashboard strategies list — user's active strategies
connections.loadingState: skeleton list items with pulsing; spinner per strategy item
connections.errorState: error badge on failing items; inline retry; fallback to cached data from sessionStorage
connections.emptyState: empty group header 'No active strategies' with CTA to Builder workspace
connections.notes: Strategy metadata (name, APY, staked amount, loops, last run) is public data. Encrypted TVL per strategy needs FHE path.

connections.forgeElement: Dashboard activity list — recent user activity
connections.forgeSection: Dashboard() — List rail: Recent Activity group
connections.loadingState: skeleton activity rows; last-cached activities shown with 'refreshing...' indicator
connections.errorState: inline error per row; 'Activity feed unavailable' banner with retry
connections.emptyState: empty group 'No recent activity' with CTA to perform first action
connections.notes: Activity events from indexed on-chain data. WebSocket subscription for real-time updates optional. Polling fallback every 15s.

connections.forgeElement: Dashboard Overview — stat tiles (Net value, LTV, Permit status, Gas/ETH)
connections.loadingState: skeleton stat tiles with pulsing; Cipher components in locked state
connections.errorState: muted stat value with warning icon; tooltip with error detail
connections.emptyState: tiles show '—' when no wallet connected or no positions exist
connections.notes: Net value (FHE path: encrypted balances × public oracle prices), LTV (public health factor), Permit status (cofhe SDK), Gas/ETH (public provider balance). Mixed FHE/public path.

connections.forgeElement: Lending screen — market list (5 markets with APY/TVL/util)
connections.loadingState: skeleton market rows with pulsing bars for APY/util/TVL
connections.errorState: inline error badge per market; stale data with 'last updated X ago' label
connections.emptyState: empty markets list with 'No markets available' banner (unlikely, but handle graceful)
connections.notes: Market data is all public (supply APY, borrow APY, utilization, TVL, oracle price). No encryption needed. Auto-refresh 30s.

connections.forgeElement: Lending screen — supply action (amount input, encrypt, submit)
connections.loadingState: amount input disabled with spinner; 'Encrypting amount…' label; tx pending overlay with tx hash
connections.errorState: inline error on input (insufficient balance, permit required); tx failure toast with retry; gas estimation failure fallback
connections.emptyState: amount input empty with placeholder '0.00'; no position state shown as default
connections.notes: Supply requires FHE encryption of amount (InEuint128 via cofhe SDK). User must have active CoFHE permit. Two-step: encrypt with cofhe, then call shield(). shieldEth() for ETH deposits.

connections.forgeElement: Lending screen — borrow action (amount input, LTV slider, submit)
connections.loadingState: input disabled; LTV gauge pulsing; 'Checking collateral…' overlay; tx pending
connections.errorState: LTV exceeded warning (destructive color); insufficient collateral error; oracle stale warning
connections.emptyState: borrow input shows '0.00' with disabled submit until amount entered; no existing borrow shown as default
connections.notes: Borrow requires encrypted amount. LTV check is computed on ciphertext (FHE.lte). borrowWithLtvCheck uses internal FHE LTV calc, borrowWithOracle uses Pyth oracle price for health check. User must have permit.

connections.forgeElement: Lending screen — repay action
connections.loadingState: tx pending overlay; 'Repaying…' with tx hash
connections.errorState: insufficient balance error; permit expired warning; tx revert toast
connections.emptyState: amount input '0.00'; zero debt shown as confirmation state
connections.notes: Repay requires encrypted amount (InEuint128). User must have permit.

connections.forgeElement: Lending screen — withdraw/unshield action
connections.loadingState: 'Verifying encrypted balance…' with FHE proof generation indicator; tx pending
connections.errorState: insufficient supply balance error; proof generation failure; permit required
connections.emptyState: input shows '0.00'; zero supply shown when no balance
connections.notes: Withdraw needs encrypted amount. unshieldWithProof requires threshold network proof (verifyDecryptResult). Two FHE paths: partialUnshield (basic, with amount + encAmount) and unshieldWithProof (with FHE verifyDecryptResult proof).

connections.forgeElement: Market (Strategies) screen — community strategy listings
connections.loadingState: skeleton list items (6 rows) with pulsing bars
connections.errorState: error banner 'Strategy feed unavailable' with retry; stale cached data fallback
connections.emptyState: empty community group 'No strategies yet' with CTA to create first one
connections.notes: Strategy listing data is public. Metadata includes name, author, risk level, APY, TVL, asset, deployer count. Template references used by builder.

connections.forgeElement: Governance screen — proposal listings
connections.loadingState: skeleton list items (5 rows) with pulsing status tags
connections.errorState: error banner 'Governance feed unavailable' with retry
connections.emptyState: empty groups with 'No proposals' label; active group shown first even if empty
connections.notes: Governance proposal data is public. Grouped by status: Active, Queued, Executed, Defeated.

connections.forgeElement: Governance screen — cast vote (for/against/abstain)
connections.loadingState: vote button disabled with spinner; 'Submitting vote…' label; tx pending if on-chain
connections.errorState: vote expired warning; duplicate vote error; JWT expired re-auth flow; tx revert
connections.emptyState: vote panel shows disabled state when wallet not connected or proposal not active
connections.notes: Voting requires JWT auth (wallet signature). Vote data goes to NestJS API which may relay on-chain. JWT refresh needed if session expired.

connections.forgeElement: Governance screen — proposal detail with tally bar, quorum meter
connections.loadingState: skeleton detail pane with pulsing tally bar and quorum meter
connections.errorState: error detail banner 'Proposal not found' with back navigation
connections.emptyState: no proposal selected shows detail placeholder with 'Select a proposal' prompt
connections.notes: Single proposal detail with full metadata: title, body, for/against/abstain votes, quorum, time left, proposer.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — simulation engine (walk order step-through)
connections.loadingState: pulsing node border on active step; status bar 'Simulating step X/Y…'; estimated gas display
connections.errorState: simulation error per step (red border); inline error on failing node; 'Simulation failed' banner
connections.emptyState: simulate button disabled when canvas is empty; 'Add nodes to simulate' tooltip
connections.notes: Simulation uses NestJS backend which coordinates SwapSimulator, SupplySimulator, BorrowSimulator services. Returns simulated steps, estimated gas, expected output. Currently the forge canvas is a custom SVG (not ReactFlow) — the adapter must handle this.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — AI strategy builder from natural language
connections.loadingState: 'Analyzing intent…' with Gemini AI processing indicator; streaming step generation
connections.errorState: rate limit error (429 — 5 req/60s); invalid intent message; AI failure fallback
connections.emptyState: text input placeholder 'Describe your strategy…' with example prompts
connections.notes: Gemini AI parses natural language → returns strategy steps. Requires JWT auth. Rate limited to 5 requests per 60s.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — deploy flow (progress modal, toast)
connections.loadingState: DeployProgressModal step-through: 'Signing…' → 'Confirming…' → 'Executed!'; tx hash display
connections.errorState: reverted tx toast with error reason; gas estimation failure; permit expired mid-flow
connections.emptyState: deploy button disabled when canvas has no valid workflow; 'Build a workflow first' tooltip
connections.notes: Deploy requires FHE encrypted parameters (InEuint128 amounts for supply/borrow steps). Uses Composer.openPosition() which chains vault→pool→swap in one atomic tx. User must have CoFHE permit before deploying.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — per-link DeFi operation estimation
connections.loadingState: estimatedOut/gas/priceImpact shown as pulsing skeletons while calculating
connections.errorState: estimation failure inline warning; 'Unable to estimate' fallback with manual input
connections.emptyState: no estimate shown until token pair and amount are configured
connections.notes: Estimates token swap/supply/borrow output. Used in inline node config overlay. Public data, no encryption needed.

connections.forgeElement: TopBar — WalletChip (address display, chain ID)
connections.loadingState: skeleton chip with pulsing address placeholder 'Connecting…'
connections.errorState: chain mismatch warning icon; wrong network label (non-Arb Sepolia)
connections.emptyState: 'Connect wallet' button shown when no account connected
connections.notes: Direct wagmi integration: useAccount() provides address (string), chainId (number). WalletChip truncates address to 0x9f3a…b4a39 format.

connections.forgeElement: TopBar — PermitChip (FHE permit status countdown)
connections.loadingState: skeleton chip with pulsing; 'Checking permit…' label
connections.errorState: permit expired warning (yellow → red as time runs out); grant failed error
connections.emptyState: locked state shows 'permit · locked' with click-to-grant CTA
connections.notes: CoFHE SDK hook integration. PermitChip shows live countdown (MM:SS). When secondsLeft ≤ 0, auto-locks and shows locked state. Permit renewal triggers grantPermit() flow.

connections.forgeElement: Cipher — encrypted value display component
connections.loadingState: locked state with blurred ciphertext + 'encrypted' lock-mark; pulsing during decrypt
connections.errorState: decrypt failure shows '🔒' fallback with 'Decrypt failed' tooltip
connections.emptyState: empty value shows '—' (em dash) in locked state
connections.notes: Central to FHE UX. Cipher component shows blurred text when locked (locked=true), plaintext when unlocked (locked=false). Uses staggeredReveal with 50ms per-element delay. Multiple sizes: sm/md/lg/xl/xxl.

connections.forgeElement: LtvGauge — loan-to-value horizontal meter
connections.backendSource: LendingPool.borrow balance + supply balance + PriceOracle prices → LTV ratio calculation
connections.loadingState: gauge bar pulsing with 'Calculating LTV…' label
connections.errorState: oracle stale warning; 'LTV unavailable' with muted gauge
connections.emptyState: gauge at 0% when no borrow position exists; no label shown
connections.notes: LTV = borrowValue / (supplyValue * collateralFactor). Requires encrypted balance reveal → then public price → ratio. Mixed FHE/public path. Color transitions ink→accent→danger as LTV approaches liquidation threshold.

connections.forgeElement: Spark — inline sparkline chart
connections.backendSource: Historical price data (from NestJS stats or subgraph)
connections.loadingState: flat line with pulsing; no data point labels
connections.errorState: flat line with 'data unavailable' tooltip
connections.emptyState: horizontal dash line when no data points exist
connections.notes: GAP: No dedicated historical stats endpoint in current backend-manifest. May need new endpoint or use subgraph data.

connections.forgeElement: ConnectModal Step 1 — sign message (EIP-191 nonce)
connections.loadingState: 'Generating nonce…' spinner on sign button; 'Verifying signature…' overlay
connections.errorState: nonce expired; invalid signature error; JWT mint failure; 'Authentication failed' toast
connections.emptyState: sign button shows 'Sign message' with message preview; disabled until wallet picked
connections.notes: JWT-based auth: fetch nonce → wallet signs EIP-191 message → POST to wallet-login → receive JWT → store for subsequent API calls. JWT expires 15min (HS256). Chain ID stored in auth_nonces table.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — risk analysis via Gemini AI
connections.loadingState: 'Analyzing risk…' with Gemini AI processing spinner
connections.errorState: rate limit warning; AI analysis failure fallback with generic risk disclaimer
connections.emptyState: risk panel disabled until strategy has at least 2 nodes with configured amounts
connections.notes: Gemini AI analyzes strategy steps and returns risk factors + recommendations. Requires JWT auth. Rate limited.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — strategy optimization via Gemini AI
connections.loadingState: 'Optimizing…' with Gemini AI processing indicator
connections.errorState: rate limit; optimization failure with original strategy preserved
connections.emptyState: disabled until strategy has valid workflow with at least 3 nodes
connections.notes: Gemini AI suggests optimization improvements to strategy steps. Requires JWT auth.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — save draft as DeFi strategy
connections.loadingState: 'Saving…' spinner on save button; status bar 'Saved' timestamp updates
connections.errorState: save conflict error; network failure with local-draft persistence fallback
connections.emptyState: create new draft — button says 'Save as new strategy' before first save
connections.notes: Drafts persisted in localStorage by default. Backend save syncs to NestJS for persistent storage and sharing. JWT required.

connections.forgeElement: User profile data (wallet-based user lookup)
connections.loadingState: skeleton avatar/name; 'Loading profile…'
connections.errorState: user not found (404)→show create prompt; network error→muted fallback with address-only display
connections.emptyState: new user prompt — 'Welcome! Create your profile' with inline form
connections.notes: User profile is created on first auth. Username, wallet address, metadata. JWT required for mutations.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace deploy — Composer.openPosition()
connections.loadingState: multi-step tx signing: vault→pool→swap sequential confirmations; gas estimation pending
connections.errorState: step failure reversion; gas too low; Composer not approved (ERC20 approval needed)
connections.emptyState: deploy button disabled when no workflow nodes configured
connections.notes: Composer.openPosition() chains vault collateral deposit → lending pool supply/borrow → swap router token conversion in one atomic tx. Pre-approve Composer via ERC20 transferFrom. Requires 3 encrypted InEuint128 params.

connections.forgeElement: Builder workspace — DeFi module lookup (node types: Supply, Borrow, Swap, Repeat, Settle)
connections.loadingState: skeleton palette items; pulsing node type cards while modules load
connections.errorState: module fetch failure → fallback to hardcoded 5 node types with static configs
connections.emptyState: palette shows disabled items with 'No modules available' if empty
connections.notes: Defi modules define available on-chain operations. Each module has associated actions (SWAP, SUPPLY, BORROW). Used to populate the builder node palette.

walletContextMapping.description: Per-field mapping of forge wallet context (ctx) to wagmi/@cofhe SDK hooks
walletContextMapping.contextSource: ui/app.jsx — useStateA({ connected: t.startConnected, address: "0x9f3a2c4b1e0d8f7a6c5b4a39", permitUnlocked: t.startConnected && t.startUnlocked, permitSeconds: t.startConnected && t.startUnlocked ? 14 * 60 : 0, revealing: false })

fields.errorState: connection error from wagmi — useAccount().connector?.getProvider() or connect error
fields.emptyState: false (disconnected) — default state before wallet connect
fields.notes: Direct 1:1 mapping. Adapter: useForgeAdapter() → ctx.connected = isConnected. wagmi reconnects automatically via injected connector.

fields.loadingState: undefined while connecting; set after connection established
fields.errorState: null on disconnect or chain switch with account change
fields.emptyState: '' (empty string) — initial state before wallet connect
fields.notes: Direct 1:1 mapping. Adapter: ctx.address = address || ''. Address is checksummed by wagmi.

fields.loadingState: false while checking permit state; usePermitStatus() could be 'loading'
fields.errorState: false if permit expired or grant failed; check permit error from cofhe
fields.emptyState: false — initial state before permit is granted
fields.notes: CoFHE SDK integration. unlocked indicates if decrypt handles are active. Adapter: ctx.permitUnlocked = unlocked.

fields.loadingState: 0 while loading; updated after permit state resolves
fields.errorState: 0 when permit expired or never granted
fields.notes: Countdown from permit expiry (15 min = 900s). Decremented locally via useInterval. Adapter: ctx.permitSeconds = secondsLeft.

fields.errorState: false if reveal fails — individual Cipher components show locked fallback
fields.emptyState: false — initial state before any reveal triggered
fields.notes: State-driven reveal flag. StaggeredReveal applies 50ms per-element delay sorted by DOM top position. Used for progressive disclosure animation.

fields.emptyState: undefined — no chain before wallet connect
fields.notes: PLANNED — No direct chainId field currently exists in the ctx state object in ui/app.jsx. The actual ctx state has: connected, address, permitUnlocked, permitSeconds, revealing only. chainId is inferred from wagmi useAccount() but not surfaced in ctx. Network chip in TopBar shows "Arb·Sepolia". Chain mismatch triggers switch network flow.

fields.emptyState: empty array — no handles before permit
fields.notes: FHE handles represent encrypted values user has granted access to. Not directly exposed in current ctx but used internally.

connectModalSteps.description: Mapping of the 4-step connect modal flow to backend/wagmi/cofhe sources

steps.name: Pick a wallet
steps.backendSource: wagmi useConnect() + connectors (MetaMask, Rabby, WalletConnect, Ledger)
steps.loadingState: wallet options grid loading with skeleton cards; disabled while initialization pending
steps.errorState: connector unavailable (not injected); 'No wallet detected' prompt with install link
steps.emptyState: no connectors available → 'install a wallet' empty state with download links
steps.notes: 4 wallet options displayed in 2×2 grid: MetaMask, Rabby, WalletConnect, Ledger. Continue button advances to Step 1 after selection.

steps.name: Sign message
steps.loadingState: 'Signing…' spinner after user clicks Sign; nonce generation pending
steps.errorState: user rejected signature in wallet; nonce expired; JWT mint failure → retry option
steps.emptyState: sign message preview with address, nonce, chain shown before user action
steps.notes: Two-step API interaction: fetch nonce from backend, wallet signs EIP-191 message, backend verifies and returns JWT. Sets ctx.connected = true after success.

steps.name: Grant CoFHE permit
steps.loadingState: 'Granting permit…' with spinner; cofhe SDK wallet interaction pending
steps.errorState: user rejected permit grant; permit timeout; grant failed → back to step 1 or retry
steps.emptyState: permit info screen with scope explanation (your handles), expiry (15 min), cost (0 gas)
steps.notes: CoFHE SDK permit grants access to decrypt FHE handles. 15-minute expiry. Sets ctx.permitUnlocked = true and ctx.permitSeconds = 900 after success.

steps.name: Ready / Connected
steps.notes: Confirmation step with 'permit live' tag, success message ('You can read your numbers.'), animated pulse line. Auto-dismisses modal after 1.6s timeout.

connectModalSteps.flowSummary: Step 0 (wagmi connect) → Step 1 (wallet sign + JWT auth) → Step 2 (cofhe permit) → Step 3 (ready). Steps persist in sessionStorage for mid-flow refresh resilience. Step progression auto-detects from ctx state on modal open.

gaps.description: Forge features with no direct backend equivalent — needs new endpoints, contracts, or will remain as mock-only

items.forgeElement: Custom SVG Canvas (dot grid, 3-layer edges, node rendering engine)
items.description: Forge uses a custom SVG canvas (2107 lines) with dot-grid background, three SVG edge layers (halo/stroke/hit), zoom layer, and port connection system. This is a pure frontend rendering concern. No backend equivalent needed.
items.recommendation: Keep as pure frontend. Bridge layer should NOT attempt to abstract the canvas. However, the custom canvas means adapter code must integrate with forge's DOM, not ReactFlow API.

items.description: Forge implements 50+ keyboard shortcuts natively (Tab cycle, 1-5 quick add, arrow nudge, ⌘Z/⌘C/⌘V, H hand tool, V select, S simulate, F fullscreen, ? cheatsheet, etc.). Pure frontend feature.
items.recommendation: Keep as frontend-only. No backend equivalent.

items.forgeElement: Undo/Redo system (history stack, max 50, debounced snapshots)
items.description: Forge implements its own undo/redo with history stack and debounced snapshot push. Pure client-side state management.
items.recommendation: Keep as frontend-only. No backend equivalent.

items.forgeElement: Issue Detection Engine (4 rules: cycles, dead-ends, missing settle, consecutive swaps)
items.description: Forge detects workflow issues client-side: DFS cycle detection, dead-end nodes, missing Settle node, consecutive swap merge tips. Purely algorithmic on graph state.
items.recommendation: Keep as frontend-only. No backend equivalent for now. Could be enhanced with backend validation later.

items.description: Forge implements width-aware layered layout with median heuristic. Pure graph visualization algorithm — no backend needed.
items.recommendation: Keep as frontend-only. No backend equivalent.

items.forgeElement: Draft Management (localStorage persistence, private drafts before publish)
items.description: Forge stores drafts in localStorage with auto-save. Currently no backend endpoint for saving private draft state before explicit publish. Backend has POST/PUT/DELETE for published strategies.
items.recommendation: Needs new draft-specific API endpoint if cloud sync wanted. Otherwise keep as localStorage-only.

items.description: Forge has a Spark component expecting historical data points (number[]). No dedicated historical price/APY endpoint in current backend-manifest.
items.recommendation: Needs new endpoint: GET /markets/history?asset={asset}&period={24h|7d|30d} or similar. Alternatively, frontend could calculate from indexed events.

items.forgeElement: Tweaks Panel (entire dev panel: theme toggles, wallet state simulation, route nav)
items.description: Developer debugging panel for prototype mode. Not a production feature — mock-only with host protocol communication pattern.
items.recommendation: mock-only. Strip in production build or gate behind __DEV__ flag.

items.forgeElement: Theme persistence and toggle (localStorage-based, no backend storage)
items.description: Theme selection is persisted to localStorage only. No backend user preference endpoint exists.
items.recommendation: Keep client-side. Theme preference is not a backend concern until user preference sync is needed.

items.forgeElement: Landing page auto-play cipher demo cycle (6.5s)
items.description: Mock demo cycle on landing page that auto-plays cipher locked/unlocked animation. Purely visual demo, no backend equivalent.
items.recommendation: Keep as mock. Should be replaced with real data once wallet is connected but preserved as landing page animation for non-connected visitors.

items.forgeElement: Governance on-chain voting (direct contract interaction for vote casting)
items.description: Current governance endpoint only handles off-chain voting. On-chain governance (GovernorBravo, FFT token voting) may require additional contract integration beyond the NestJS API.
items.recommendation: Needs investigation: does the NestJS vote endpoint also relay to GovernorBravo contract? If not, needs contract write integration for on-chain voting.

items.description: Dashboard activity currently relies on polling via GET /activities. No WebSocket or SSE endpoint exists for real-time push updates.
items.recommendation: Possible enhancement: WebSocket gateway for real-time activity push. Not blocking — polling fallback works.

dependencyGraph.description: Forge feature → required backend service/contract dependency chains

to: Client-side only (custom SVG rendering, no backend dependency)

loadingErrorEmptyMatrix.description: Standardized loading/error/empty state patterns across connection types

api-get-list.loading: skeleton rows with pulsing animation (matching list item height); header skeleton for grouped lists
api-get-list.error: inline error banner with retry button; fallback to cached data with 'last updated X ago' label
api-get-list.empty: empty group header with descriptive message and CTA button; illustration (optional) for main empty states

api-get-detail.loading: skeleton detail pane with structural placeholders (tiles, gauges, text blocks)
api-get-detail.error: error detail banner with back navigation; 'Not found' fallback for 404
api-get-detail.empty: detail pane placeholder with 'Select an item' prompt; detail-level empty state for new/unconfigured items

api-post-mutation.loading: submit button → disabled spinner; overlay with tx status; 'Processing…' label
api-post-mutation.error: inline toast notification with error reason + retry; field-level validation errors
api-post-mutation.empty: form with default/placeholder values; submit button disabled until valid input

contract-read-fhe.loading: Cipher component in locked state; pulsing skeleton for non-cipher values; 'Decrypting…' for reveal
contract-read-fhe.error: locked state fallback with 'Decrypt failed' tooltip; inline warning for permit expired
contract-read-fhe.empty: Cipher shows '—' for zero/empty values; locked state for unpermitted access

contract-read-public.loading: pulsing skeleton for numeric values; gauge bar in indeterminate state
contract-read-public.error: muted value with warning icon; stale data indicator with fallback
contract-read-public.empty: '—' (em dash) for zero values; gauge at 0% with no label

contract-write-fhe.loading: tx pending overlay with step indicators; 'Encrypting amount…' phase before tx; gas estimation spinner
contract-write-fhe.error: tx reverted toast with reason; permit expired inline warning; insufficient balance error
contract-write-fhe.empty: action inputs at default state (0.00); submit button disabled

wallet-connect.loading: wallet selection cards with disabled state; 'Connecting…' on selected wallet
wallet-connect.error: user rejected connection toast; no wallet detected prompt with install link
wallet-connect.empty: wallet options grid shown; connect button CTA

fheReveal.loading: staggeredReveal with 50ms per-element delay; Cipher components transition locked→unlocked one by one
fheReveal.error: individual Cipher falls back to locked state; 'Some values could not be decrypted' summary
fheReveal.empty: all Cipher values show '—' after reveal (all empty portfolios)

permitExpiry.loading: countdown timer running; PermitChip in live state
permitExpiry.error: PermitChip shows locked state; auto-lock triggers re-grant flow; inline snackbar 'Permit expired'
permitExpiry.empty: locked state with 'Grant permit' CTA before any FHE operations

networkMismatch.loading: checking chain ID… spinner in network chip
networkMismatch.error: red network chip with 'Wrong network' label; switch network prompt modal
networkMismatch.empty: network chip shows chain ID after connection; hidden when disconnected

jwtExpiry.loading: silent refresh attempt using stored refresh mechanism
jwtExpiry.error: re-auth prompt: 'Session expired. Please sign again.' in a toast/modal
jwtExpiry.empty: no JWT → protected API calls return 401 → fallback to unauthenticated state
